name: Lewis' Note
summary: At Sentinel Hill, Quartermaster Lewis sends an urgent supply requisition to a private armorer in Stormwind. A courier carries it by gryphon, asking for protective gear for the Westfall garrison.

sections.title: A Plea for Steel
sections.body: The People's Militia at Sentinel Hill gets little support from Stormwind's House of Nobles. Skirmishes with the Defias Brotherhood keep draining its meager stocks of gear. To keep the defenders outfitted, Quartermaster Lewis turns to private business instead of crown supplies. His requisition bypasses official military channels entirely. An Alliance courier must fly by gryphon to Old Town and present the order to Osric Strang, proprietor of Limited Immunity.

faq.answer: Lewis' Note is Quartermaster Lewis's written order asking Osric Strang, an armorer in Stormwind, to send protective equipment to the struggling Westfall garrison.
Quartermaster Lewis wrote the note. He manages supplies, provisions, and armaments for the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill.
The note goes first to Thor, the gryphon master at Sentinel Hill. From there, it is delivered directly to Osric Strang inside his armor shop, Limited Immunity, in Stormwind's Old Town.

faq.q: Why doesn't the garrison just get armor from the kingdom?
faq.answer: Stormwind's government has largely neglected Westfall, leaving its defenders without direct military funding or crown-supplied armor. Lewis relies on trade contacts such as Osric Strang to keep the militia equipped.

angles.text: Delivering the requisition teaches young human adventurers how to use the kingdom's gryphon network and shows how little Stormwind's rulers do to equip Westfall's defenders.
